question.sourceEnglish: A soil jar still has cloudy water above the sand layer. What should the farmer conclude?
question.draft: Nkho ya mobu e sa ntse e na le cloudy water ka hodima lera la sand. Molemi o lokela ho fihlela qeto efe?

options.sourceEnglish: The soil definitely needs less water
options.draft: Mobu o hloka metsi a fokolang ka nnete

options.sourceEnglish: Fine particles may still be suspended; more observation is needed
options.draft: Fine particles di ka nna tsa sala di suspended; ho hlokahala further observation

options.sourceEnglish: All the clay has already settled
options.draft: Letsopa lohle le se le dutse fatshe
Sejalo se hloka gypsum ka nnete

rationale.sourceEnglish: Cloudy water can contain unsettled fine particles. One early observation cannot establish the final proportions or the right treatment.
rationale.draft: Cloudy water e ka ba le fine particles tse eso dule fatshe. Ho sheba hang feela qalong ho ke ke ha bontsha final proportions kapa treatment e loketseng.

note: Candidate-only, source-bound Sesotho machine draft. It preserves the uncertainty that particles may remain suspended and that one early observation cannot establish proportions or treatment. It does not prescribe a treatment.
